bodyDescription: A tasty treat for your dog consisting of beef rawhide, beef & chicken. These chew sticks are delicious, provide chewing pleasure and therefore contribute to healthy teeth. Moreover, this snack is rich in animal protein. Due to their size, these sticks are very suitable for larger breeds.
